derived_claims: The purpose of the visualization is to illustrate the dramatic shift from a completely rural global population to a predominantly urban one, alongside the massive scale of global population growth in the modern era.

The extremely long time scale (12,000 years) highlights how unprecedented the modern population explosion and urbanization trend is in the context of human history.
